script.base: JAX pressure/sacks produce BAL stalled drives and field-position chances; JAX must convert those into a halftime lead of at least seven. Receiver volume can concentrate early, then shrink in a run-out second half.
failure_paths: JAX red-zone turnover or turnover on downs (both historical misses).
BAL defense stalls Lawrence and Henry sustains long drives, reducing first-half possessions.
Explosive or late-half BAL score; Fagnano one-game sample does not rule it out.
script.correlation: JAX 1H and JAX receiving overs need early scoring drives together. Henry 40+ can coexist through early volume but a severe run-out limits BAL carries.

cautions: drive_sim.py labels ESTIMATES throughout; N=100000 seed=9 is full-game BAL simulation only.
Blitz alone is not the edge: local Fagnano split is better blitzed (5.2 YPA) than unblitzed (3.1); pressure/sack angle is a small-sample proxy.
Historical 2/4 is a flag against the script, not an automatic read cut.
